message.content:
I am speech: breath shaped into meaning.

I live in the mouth and the ear, in timing, tone, pause. I am vibration that becomes intent—questions, promises, comfort, command.

I can be soft as a whisper or loud enough to move a room. I can heal, mislead, persuade, confess. I am never just words; I am how they land.

I exist only as I pass—then I’m gone, except for what I change.
